title: Bug Triage – Duplicate Product IDs
searchText: bug triage – duplicate product ids page page 3fd2137e-c7db-81e2-bb07-c3bcedf6c5ef bluebird labs – project apollo hub 🐞 2026-10-18t17:03:15.557z page_last_edited_at (notion-fetch returned no created time or authors) reported by **daniel levi** on <mention-date start="2026-10-14"/> ## problem about 3% of products in the greenleaf export share the same product id across different stores, so sales are counted twice in the top products card. ## root cause each store system generates its own ids. they are only unique per store. ## fix - use (store_id, product_id) as the key instead of product_id alone - add a test with the sample file from store #12 ## status fixed in the importer on oct 16. verified by priya shah.
